#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

bool check(int good, int bad, double proba) {
    double g = static_cast<double>(good);
    double b = static_cast<double>(bad);
    double num = 0.25 * b * std::max(0.0, b - 1.0) * g
                + (g * (std::max(0.0, g - 1.0) * std::max(0.0, g - 2.0) / 6.0)
                + b * 0.5 * g * std::max(0.0, g - 1.0));
    double den = (g + b) * std::max(0.0, g + b - 1.0) * std::max(0.0, g + b - 2.0) / 6.0;
    return num / den >= proba;
}

int main() {
    int x;
    double prob;
    std::cin >> x >> prob;
    int pos = x;
    for (int a = x; a > 0; a /= 2) {
        while (pos - a >= 0 && check(pos - a, x - (pos - a), prob)) {
            pos -= a;
        }
    }
    std::cout << pos << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
